setup.text: A young weaver notices an error in a sacred ceremonial pattern.

choices.label: Ask the elder to examine the flaw.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The ceremony proceeds smoothly and tradition is honored.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The flaw causes the tapestry to unravel.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The cloth holds beautifully, and the elder learns a new stitch.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some relatives feel the change breaks tradition.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The elder recognizes the error and thanks the apprentice.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The elder denies the problem until the cloth is tested.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The village gains a record of how designs evolve.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The extra weaving consumes scarce thread.
